topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I found out someone had my art tattooed on their skin. It's an odd feeling, seeing something so personal, so intimately crafted, become a part of someone else in such a permanent way. I can't help but think about the hours I spent, the meaning behind every line and color. It's flattering, really, but also... it's not just a piece of art now. It's something they chose to live with, something they see in the mirror every day. I hope it means as much to them as it does to me. I shouldn't be questioning their choice; it's a form of flattery, I know. But it's hard not to feel a little exposed.
